notes.craft: Thread proposed 3 (10 Oct 2026): The house documents a process it developed and still defines a line by (garment pleating: sewn first, pleated after), and every JP-store PDP read states the country of making. It names no maker or mill and shows no owned facility, and the pleated HOMME PLISSÉ pieces sampled are made in the Philippines while knits and IM MEN are made in Japan. Process documentation lifts it above a country-only 2;  Seated as proposed, pending ruling.

craft_evidence.owned: NONE found (evidence): Issey Miyake Inc. company profile (mynavi, 2026) lists only the Tokyo head office, no factory; no brand claim of an owned factory seen
craft_evidence.makers: NONE: 32 JP-store and 5 US-store men's PDPs read name no factory or maker
craft_evidence.mills: NONE: no mill named on any PDP read
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed (evidence): Miyake Design Studio founded 1970 by Issey Miyake (Tokyo); HOMME PLISSÉ "Launched in 2013"; IM MEN "started in 2021"; pleats work "presented in 1988" (brand pages)
craft_evidence.process: brief but specific (brand statement): garments "first sewn and then pleated to finish" (uk.isseymiyake.com Pleats Please page); HOMME PLISSÉ "founded on the technology of garment pleating"; IM MEN PDP
craft_evidence.reasoning: The house documents a process it developed and still defines a line by (garment pleating: sewn first, pleated after), and every JP-store PDP read states the country of making. It names no maker or mill and shows no owned facility, and the pleated HOMME PLISSÉ pieces sampled are made in the Philippines while knits and IM MEN are made in Japan. Process documentation lifts it above a country-only 2; nothing checkable supports a 4.
